pr_title: (fix #4721) Implement Editor Toggle to hide or show the preview Brush in the preview Window
pr_body:
This PR is for the issue #4721 

In this PR i implemented a simple function to toggle the preview brush inside the preview window with a new Menu-Item and the corrisponding Command. A preview can be seen in a little video in this PR Message (Only the first 30s are relevant - rest of the video is freezing :X).
[Aseprite-test.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/25fb4eb6-6a5c-48ea-8f2a-1a22036a4b7e)

Thanks @S4HRKBOY, I'll test this and probably modify the patch a little for the final merge/cherry-pick.

I've cherry-picked ( cd5bf499eab932061b10a8f0a22d6781e099c909 ) this with a few changes (removing unnecessary `<key>` element, sorting things by name, avoid #include `<user header file>` etc.) and added an extra patch ( d073ecd9d1fe081bb39cfb8c1f446a95c961f397 ) to show the selection transformation in the preview window (as we use the Doc's ExtraCel for such purpose too). With this patch when we transformed the selection the layer disappeared from the preview window.

issue_context.title: Disable cursor preview on Preview window
issue_context.body:
Sometimes it's useful to see the cursor preview in the Preview window to see how the sprite will look if we paint a pixel in the cursor position, at least that was my initial idea.

Some users find this troublesome: https://community.aseprite.org/t/preview-window-cursor/22880

The best would be to disable the cursor preview on the Preview window and add an option to re-enable just in case some user wants it back.
comments: Hello @dacap. I wanted to ask if i could work on this issue?
Hi @S4HRKBOY, sure you can take it  👍

Hello @dacap! I have a little question for this issue. I looked through the code and have the following problem. I identified that one location where i could manipulate the brush_preview is the `BrushPreview::show` function (which is pretty big ^^) which gets called in the editor class. My Problem (or more my idea) here is that the AppEditor and PreviewEditor (which gets instantiated in `PreviewEditorWindow::updateUsingEditor()`) share the memory addresses for Session relevant objects like Doc*, Sprite*, Site*, etc. Because of that i was only able to enable and disable the preview Brush **in both Editors** through code. I also think that i should avoid copying objects like sprite, doc is discouraged (sometimes indicated with the `DISABLE_COPYING(...)` Macro. I wanted to ask if i am missing something here maybe.?

Hello @dacap. I think after some digging i found the correct piece of  UI-code `ExtraCelRef` which needed to be adapted. This is the result of that. I think that is the way this issue was supposed to be solved ?! (The Video ends after 30s somehow it kept recording :X)
